subject: FLA causal-conv parity complete: modest T512 win, not primary bottleneck
body: Non-mutating exact-shape Qwen3.5 causal-conv parity is complete using real base conv weight D=8192,W=4,bf16,silu on RTX3050/SM86. T128: torch reference warm fwd+bwd 1.244ms vs FLA Triton 1.572ms (FLA slower). T512: torch reference 4.584ms vs FLA Triton 3.320ms (~1.38x speedup). T512 forward relative-L2 0.002871, input-grad relative-L2 0.002738; max abs forward .00390625, grad .001953125. Absolute saving ~1.26ms per layer-op, so direct causal-conv replacement is not the dominant full-run speed lever. Do not spend effort compiling/installing causal-conv1d or adding kernels package solely for this bottleneck right now. FLA DeltaNet core remains the meaningful acceleration subject. Evidence persisted Lane-A head 2dba99a48b846386a19acdeeb7fcd0e0f58c2668; receipt file SHA 24171cb705e518893b0c2350c89e0c82598b907d1173c88053e686fda7477488. GPU released.
